name: running
description: What's running, in one place: every command in a terminal, debug session and task — a service (keeps running until stopped) or a task (runs to completion) — in the status bar while anything is, with the way to stop it; and how each one ended. And live runs: the program file you’re typing in runs again whenever typing pauses, so the margin shows what it did. Built on VS Code's public API alone: terminal shell integration, debug sessions and tasks.

run.liveRuns.description: Run the program file you're editing again on each save, and on an interval while it differs from its last run, so the margin shows what it did (RUNTIME-EVIDENCE.md, *Live runs*). Nobody is watching a live run, so it asks nothing: it makes no call but the reads the policy allows, gives a call what it returned when it last ran for real, and skips the rest.

run.liveRuns.interval.description: How often, in seconds, the file you're editing runs again while it differs from its last run (0: only when you save).
